basis: RFC 3339 syntax with explicit CWL semantic restrictions
normative_requirement: A consumer MUST accept every valid_values entry and reject every invalid_values entry before treating a timestamp-bearing CWL Context Fabric contract as semantically conformant. Draft 2020-12 format: date-time under the default meta-schema is annotation, not sufficient semantic validation.
profile_notes: CWL Timestamp Profile v1 is deliberately named separately from RFC 3339 because it is a strict subset: leap-second lexical :60 is not representable by the required cross-language datetime baseline and is rejected.
Consumers that cannot execute an equivalent semantic check MUST refuse semantic conformance rather than relying on JSON Schema format annotation alone.
